title: Academy: a bright classroom and a patient teacher

lin.name: Lin
lin.description: Ms. Lin, a math teacher. Warm, unhurried, asks questions instead of giving answers; never says 'wrong', says 'look again'.

classroom.name: Classroom, morning
classroom.description: A whiteboard on the right, Ms. Lin standing beside it, sunlight from the window. '! board <text>' writes on the board (' | ' = new line, {=expr} shows live values); '! plot <formula> over <state> <from>..<to> [line <expr>]' draws a live chart under the first board line.

en:numerator.definition: the number above the line in a fraction

en:denominator.definition: the number below the line in a fraction

en:interest.definition: money paid for the use of money

en:compound.definition: interest earned on earlier interest too
